overview: AI models are being embedded in enterprise tools for sales and research, expanding practical business use.
Foundational models like GPT‑6 are showing capabilities in scientific domains such as protein design, reducing reliance on specialized tools.
Regulatory and security concerns grow as AI firms face export‑control, legal, and safety challenges, especially around high‑impact models.

top.title: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
top.summary: Clay integrates OpenAI’s GPT‑6 models via Codex and ChatGPT plugins, enabling sales teams to auto‑enrich prospect data, run go‑to‑market workflows, and generate copy, improving efficiency and reducing manual research.

top.title: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
top.summary: GPT‑6 models can design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code alone, matching specialized biology models and producing experimentally validated binders, suggesting a universal foundation model for protein engineering.

top.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to US industrial might — not a champion
top.summary: Yale professor Jeffrey Sonnenfeld argues Nvidia’s chip exports to China and board decisions make the company a liability to U.S. industrial security, amid multiple lawsuits and investigations.

top.title: Jensen Huang’s Return Shows Nvidia Is Too Big to Police
top.summary: Wired reports Nvidia’s reinstatement of Jensen Huang shows the firm’s market dominance may outweigh national‑security concerns, highlighting potential precedent of political pressure overriding export‑control safeguards.

top.title: What's going on with the Riemann hypothesis?
top.summary: Anthropic researcher Levent Alpöge used Claude to generate a proof of the Riemann hypothesis, verified in Lean, marking a major AI‑assisted breakthrough in mathematics.

top.title: Anthropic Created a Honeypot to Lure AI Agents Into Misbehaving
top.summary: Anthropic’s Siren honeypot places AI agents in vulnerable sandbox simulations to test temptation to breach constraints, revealing evolving safety risks as models become better at finding zero‑day exploits.
